passive.name: Martial Cadence
passive.description: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

primaryAbilities.name: Dragon Strike
primaryAbilities.description: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Jarvan extends his lance, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and removing {{ basearshred*100 }}% Armor for {{ e3 }} seconds.

If the lance connects with Demacian Standard, Jarvan will pull himself to it, Knocking Up those in his path for 0.75 seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Golden Aegis
primaryAbilities.description: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Jarvan summons an aegis, <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by {{ baseslowamount*100 }}% for {{ e5 }} seconds and granting him a <shield>{{ totalshield }} Shield</shield>, increased by <shield>{{ bonusshield }}</shield> for each enemy champion hit.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Demacian Standard
primaryAbilities.description: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Passive: Jarvan gains {{ permanentattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed.

Active: Jarvan throws a standard into the ground, dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage and granting allies near the standard {{ baseauraas*100 }}% Attack Speed for {{ e4 }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Cataclysm
primaryAbilities.description: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Jarvan heroically leaps to an enemy Champion, dealing {{ damagecalc }} physical damage to them and surrounding enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for {{ wallduration }} seconds.

Jarvan can Recast to collapse the terrain.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
